entry: flat; prior close below trend MA; prior oscillator non-negative and falling; volume > 0 -> SELL
exit: short for a full bar; prior oscillator rising; current high crosses prior N-bar high; volume > 0 -> BUY
entry_price_source: No price is stored; source documentation assumes Open and the string signal carries no price.
exit_price_source: _prev_exits is a trigger threshold, not a fill. Max(Open, ExitS[1]) is documented but not emitted.
execution_assumptions: SELL immediately sets internal position to -1
BUY immediately sets internal position to 0
